input.command:
bash -c "cat > /root/ratekv/wait_and_run_gemma2.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# Wait for ModelScope download to complete, then run pipeline
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/ratekv

export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1

MODEL_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/google/gemma-2-9b

echo \"[$(date)] Waiting for model download to complete...\"

# Wait for all 8 safetensors files to appear and be fully written
while true; do
    N_FILES=\$(ls \${MODEL_DIR}/model-*.safetensors 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    if [ \"\$N_FILES\" -eq 8 ]; then
        # Check no .incomplete or temp files
        N_TEMP=\$(ls \${MODEL_DIR}/*.tmp \${MODEL_DIR}/*.incomplete 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
        if [ \"\$N_TEMP\" -eq 0 ]; then
            # Verify download PID is done
            if ! ps -p \$(cat /tmp/gemma2_dl_pid 2>/dev/null || echo 0) > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                echo \"[$(date)] All 8 shards present, no temp files, download process done.\"
                break
            fi
        fi
    fi
    echo \"[$(date)] \${N_FILES}/8 shards ready, waiting...\"
    sleep 120
done

echo \"[$(date)] Starting Gemma-2-9B full pipeline...\"
python -u run_gemma2_full_pipeline.py 2>&1 | tee gemma2_full.log
echo \"[$(date)] Pipeline complete. Exit code: \$?\"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/ratekv/wait_and_run_gemma2.sh
echo \$! > /tmp/gemma2_dl_pid || echo 227100 > /tmp/gemma2_dl_pid
